title: The water cycle

steps.label: Evaporation
steps.caption: The sun warms the sea. Water rises as vapour.

steps.label: Condensation
steps.caption: High up, the vapour cools into cloud droplets.

steps.label: Precipitation
steps.caption: Droplets join until they are heavy enough to fall.

steps.label: Collection
steps.caption: Rivers carry the water back to the sea.

takeaway: Same water, round and round, for billions of years.
